title: Refuse the assumed-empty optional-property guard for MSBuild intrinsic properties
outcome: Refuse the assumed-empty optional-property guard for MSBuild intrinsic properties
acceptance: Known MSBuild-provided property names are excluded from the optional-empty policy without broadening invariant-property proofs or reserved-assignment refusal; ordinary optional user properties retain the approved behavior.

PropertyGroup guards on missing MSBuildThisFileDirectory and MSBuildProjectDirectory refuse with fsharp_semantic_condition_property_unresolved and no fsharp_semantic_optional_property_assumed_empty reason.
disposal_reason: Greg requested an agreed follow-up plan with Fable. Continue that planned work independently of the completed Private/optional-guard batch so it is discoverable and claimable; preserve original review provenance in notes.
